Tool button

Source: R/action-menu.R
tool_button.Rd

The design system's icon button: 26px, bare, the icon muted until hover. It has no text, so it carries its name as a tooltip (the light card of Blockr.tooltip) and as its accessible name.

Usage

tool_button(icon, tooltip, ...)

Arguments

icon

The icon, as a tag or htmltools::HTML().

tooltip

What the button does, in a few words ("Download").

...

Further attributes, such as id.

Value

A <button> htmltools::tag carrying controls_dep().

Examples

tool_button(htmltools::HTML("&darr;"), "Download")
#> <button type="button" class="blockr-tool" aria-label="Download" data-blockr-tooltip="Download">&darr;</button>
